newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Deckers Outdoor estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Deckers Outdoor estimate cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it lowered its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Deckers Outdoor Corp to $0.50 a share from a range of $0.65-$0.70 and introduced an estimate for fiscal 1998 of $0.62 a share.
-- The move was based on the company's belief that its Ugg shoe line will not show a sales increase in 1997, Gruntal said.
-- Deckers reported fourth-quarter earnings of $0.06 a share, compared to a loss of $0.34 in 1995, which was in line with the low end of Gruntal's estimate for the period.
-- Gruntal said it remains neutral on Deckers shares.
-- Deckers designs and makes specialty footwear.
-- Its shares were trading down 1/4 Friday at seven.
